principle: A resistant source may revise, split, suspend or add an executable operator only when the change is reversible, source-bound, contrastively useful and regression-gated.

conditional_families.note: ADD_OPERATOR may birth a new conditional family from a source-forced open-set candidate; the candidate remains unpromoted until regression and competition gates succeed.

generative_gestures.note: Declarative runtime executes REVISE, SPLIT, SUSPEND and ADD_OPERATOR. ADD_CONDITION remains family-trigger-specific; use REVISE to alter a gesture activation AST.

supporting_operation_vocabulary.note: This vocabulary is documentary in living-analysis 0.5 and is not traversed directly.
